description: This file provides utility functions and helpers for setting up transport mechanisms, notably for WebRTC, WebSocket telephony integrations, and SDP modifications within a Python-based server environment. It includes parsing and detection of telephony WebSocket messages, transport instantiation, SDP cleanup, and capture utilities relevant to a media/communication project.

methods.name: parse_telephony_websocket(websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Parses initial WebSocket messages to determine the telephony transport type (e.g., Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel) based on message content and returns the detected type along with provider-specific parsed data.

methods.name: str get_transport_client_id(transport: BaseTransport, client: Any)
methods.description: Returns a unique client identifier string based on the specific transport instance and client object, supporting SmallWebRTCTransport and DailyTransport.

methods.name: maybe_capture_participant_camera( transport: BaseTransport, client: Any, framerate: int = 0 )
methods.description: Attempts to trigger video capture of the participant's camera if the transport supports such an operation (with support for DailyTransport and SmallWebRTCTransport).

methods.name: maybe_capture_participant_screen( transport: BaseTransport, client: Any, framerate: int = 0 )
methods.description: Attempts to trigger screen capture for the participant if supported by the transport (DailyTransport, SmallWebRTCTransport).

methods.name: str smallwebrtc_sdp_munging(sdp: str, host: Optional[str])
methods.description: Modifies the SDP string for SmallWebRTC compatibility by removing unsupported fingerprint algorithms and ICE candidates filtering based on the host address.

methods.name: str _smallwebrtc_sdp_cleanup_ice_candidates(text: str, pattern: str)
methods.description: Filters ICE candidate lines in SDP text based on a pattern, removing unsupported candidates.

methods.name: str _smallwebrtc_sdp_cleanup_fingerprints(text: str)
methods.description: Removes SHA-384 and SHA-512 fingerprint lines from the SDP text to maintain compatibility.

methods.name: Any _get_transport_params(transport_key: str, transport_params: Dict[str, Callable])
methods.description: Retrieves transport parameters by invoking factory functions stored in a dictionary, with error handling for missing keys.

methods.name: BaseTransport create_transport( runner_args: Any, transport_params: Dict[str, Callable] )
methods.description: Main factory function that creates and returns a transport instance based on runner arguments, supporting Daily, SmallWebRTC, and WebSocket telephony transports. It utilizes transport parameter factory functions and may parse WebSocket messages to determine telephony provider types.

methods.name: BaseTransport _create_telephony_transport( websocket: WebSocket, params: Optional[Any] = None, transport_type: str = None, call_data: dict = None, )

ctags.signature: ( websocket: WebSocket, params: Optional[Any] = None, transport_type: str = None, call_data: dict = None, )
